TermTranslation.definition: Removing all of the tumour or abnormal tissue, along with some normal tissue around it, to look at them under a microscope.
Removing a small sample of the tumour or abnormal tissue to look at it under a microscope.
Removing a disc-shaped piece of skin or other tissue using a sharp, hollow tool to look at it under a microscope.
Removing the outermost layer of skin to look at it under a microscope.
A physical exam that checks for changes in or problems with the skin.
